summary: Private adaptive profiles and touch evidence overview

changes.title: Encrypted per-app profiles
changes.detail: Existing profiles migrate to a separate authenticated local file. Repeated confirmed autocorrection reversals can create a narrow learned preference; explicit overrides win. Profile details require secret authorization.

changes.title: Adaptive Touch overview
changes.detail: See retained sample counts across the alphabet, then inspect each letter's heatmap. No typed content or raw tap history is saved.

changes.title: Battery-aware optional motion
changes.detail: Power saver reduces optional key-preview and search-result effects without changing input dispatch or the accepted Emoji morph.
